exclusions.reason: This job reads the pull request description and file list through the GitHub API and decides with the base-branch copy of scripts/db-change-notice.mjs. It is a pull-request text gate, not an author-measured test. The script tests run in ci.yaml.
This job builds and pushes the beta container image with registry credentials. It is a publish path, not an author-measured test.
This job builds and pushes the production container image with registry credentials. It is a publish path, not an author-measured test.
This job opens the develop to main release pull request. It is housekeeping and performs no author-measured test.
